name: hub-design-options-reader
goal: Hosted hub reader keeps stored design options, revisions and option approvals exactly, refusing corrupt options

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Root review ecdbf507 REVIEW.md: hubSchemas strips options/revises/approval.option; hubDesigns projects flat images only; hubApproval compares option approvals to all images. Contract: design-options/hub-reader/CONTRACT.md.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: Root run on old readers f2339f/deaa54/428502: frozen hub-design-options (0103c070) + corrupt (fb5b5598) + headless (250067d3) via vitest --maxWorkers=1: 11 failed, 4 passed (15), 56.80s.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Source: hubSchemas f19ccb9f, hubOptions 0342e837, hubDesigns 02941221, hubApproval a2356a04. Primary: frozen 15 green 58.48s and all 454 hub tests green on candidate d1d011dc. Region guard 5814f85d: red 4 fail/1 pass on d1d011dc, green 5/5 after repair.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Final reader guards: 21 passed in 86.62s. Whole Hub: 460 passed, 101 files, 120.53s. Six actual verification wrappers: 29 passed, 51 matcher observations, 29 records across five required states. Import-only instrumentation preserved test bodies and deadlines; old-reader replay is independent.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
